item.title: Wicklow hotel cancels 'secretive' Peter Thiel group conference
item.description:
📝 If the conference is moved to another venue in Ireland, activists will protest there instead, campaigners said on Friday. Richard Boyd Barrett, People Before Profit–Solidarity TD, said the cancellation was “a victory for people power”. He said activists were concerned that organisers may try to hold the conference at another venue.
🔗 Read more: https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/07/03/wicklow-hotel-cancels-secretive-peter-thiel-conference/
